newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF has training, radar orders.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF has training, radar orders.

text.p: French electronics firm Thomson-CSF said on Tuesday it had won a training contract from United Airlines and a radar contract from France Meteo.

United Airlines has ordered two flight simulators and a flight management and aircraft systems trainer for its Airbus Industrie and Boeing Co aircraft from the Thomson Training & Simulation unit, the company said in a statement at the Paris air show.
The French company also said it had won a contract from Meteo France, the French weather service, for long-range weather radars to cover south-east France.
